title: Secure Formal Raising: Protecting the Development of AI through Executable Properties
abstract: arXiv:2611.08042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Model raising revisits Turing's developmental view of machine intelligence. Formal Raising (FR) has recently been proposed to complement this view with explicit behavioral properties. This paper extends that proposal to the security of the raising environment. Secure Formal Raising (SFR) models policy integrity, authorization, and confidential data flow using four-valued evidence that preserves unknown and inconsistent assessments. We prove six security invariants and show that they force admission to accept only confirmed evidence. A plain-C reference implementation satisfies the invariants in a bounded exhaustive exploration, which also exposes a confused-deputy gap for tool calls that a provenance requirement closes.

translated_title: 安全形式化培育：通过可执行属性保护人工智能的发展
translated_abstract: 模型培育重新审视了图灵关于机器智能的发展观。形式化培育（FR）最近被提出，以显式的行为属性来补充这一观点。本文将该提案扩展到培育环境的安全性。安全形式化培育（SFR）使用四值证据体系对策略完整性、授权和机密数据流进行建模，该证据体系能够保留“未知”与“不一致”的评估状态。我们证明了六条安全不变式，并表明这些不变式迫使准入机制只接受已确认的证据。一个纯C语言参考实现在有界穷举探索中满足这些不变式，该探索过程还暴露了工具调用中存在的“混淆代理人”漏洞，而引入溯源要求即可弥补这一漏洞。
tldr: 本文提出安全形式化培育（SFR）框架，用保留未知与不一致状态的四值证据建模策略完整性、授权和机密数据流，证明了六条安全不变式并通过纯C参考实现的有界穷举探索加以验证，同时发现并借助溯源要求修复了工具调用中的混淆代理人漏洞。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Secure Formal Raising (SFR), which models policy integrity, authorization, and confidential data flow using four-valued evidence that preserves unknown and inconsistent assessments; it proves six security invariants verified by a plain-C reference implementation under bounded exhaustive exploration, and identifies and closes a confused-deputy gap in tool calls through a provenance requirement.
